summary: Switch between parent and readable OMP child conversations with top thread tabs

schema.detail: No wire or table schema change. The existing task-block SubagentSummary supplies child conversation session IDs.

compatibility.detail: Only children with task-block conversation references become tabs. Other harness children remain count-only. Child transcripts are read-only: no composer, send retry or interrupt control. Parent drafts remain mounted while browsing a child. Overflow opens a thread drawer; arrow keys navigate tabs and a sidebar count press focuses the selected tab.

recovery.detail: Presentation-only change; reverting restores the parent-only conversation without data migration.
